summary: OceanPal Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq delinquency notification for late filing of its Form 20-F for FY2025. The company has 60 days to submit a compliance plan and may receive up to a 180-day extension to October 27, 2026. No financial terms, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation were provided. This is a routine procedural notice regarding listing rule compliance, not a special situation. There is no deal structure or risk-arb angle; the event is an administrative matter with no impact on trading or corporate control.
